verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a hands-on community report that a non-programmer built a backend in n8n "with scheduled and webhook-initiated tasks", which shows the product itself runs scheduled jobs. The pack has no first-party documentation of a schedule or cron trigger, and nothing explicitly confirms recurring intervals as opposed to one-off scheduled runs. missing for 10: first-party docs for a schedule/cron trigger, explicit evidence of recurring intervals and cron expressions, timezone and missed-run handling, programmatic or AI-driven schedule management.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Our manager with zero programming skills was able to build a quite complex backend using postgres and REST APIs, with scheduled and webhook-initiated tasks.
